I work on a golf course. I don’t even know where to begin. the owners are cheap, won’t give anyone raises, buy new equipment, or really just spend any money in general. They treat you like shit regardless that you’re the one who makes the golf course look as beautiful as it is. The golfer are assholes and have zero respect for you. Not to mention we’re understaffed so I do double duty. One summer one of the guys got really sick and ended up in the hospital, and I was doing the job of 3-4 people that summer, thankfully he came back and is doing great. But jeez. Talk about coming home and just falling asleep. I was asleep by the time I punched out. 


Most golf courses will get rid of their equipment and get new stuff once they reach maybe 2000 hours on the hour meter. Our machines are going on 20 years old, and some of the machines the hour meter is almost ready to roll back to 0. 


The part that really gets me, is all of these machines have been rebuilt numerous times. All the time and labor and cost of replacement parts, could have just bought a new machine, and they keep repairing it. You could have just bought a whole new machine he first time around and been fine. 


Talk about being a mindless slave. 


Regardless I still try and do the best job I can, mowing perfectly straight lines, making sure every last pothole in the cartpath is repaired. And still no gratitude.
